title: OSCORE context bound + LRU eviction missing in all stacks (decision oscore-context-bound; spec 8.8 R-06-204/205)
description: Decision spec/decisions.jsonl oscore-context-bound (2026-09-03): 'All stacks must add LRU eviction' — MUST bound contexts, RECOMMENDED 64, minimum 8 for constrained nodes. Spec §8.8 amended this sweep to match. Code status (R-06-204/205): C lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore — Kconfig LICHEN_OSCORE_MAX_CONTEXTS default 8 range 2-32 (no enforced min-8 floor; range permits 2), NO eviction (oscore_ctx.c:377-390 returns OSCORE_ERR_NO_MEMORY when full; persist layer -ENOSPC oscore_persist.c:427-430); Python lichen/coap/secure/channel.py:144 _MAX_ACTIVE_PEER_CONTEXTS=2048 with LRU (_evict_peer_contexts_if_needed :418-449) — bound not 64; Rust lichen-node/src/secure.rs — contexts HashMap unbounded, no eviction. Constants 64 (recommended) and enforced floor 8 exist nowhere. Fix: add LRU-by-last-message-timestamp eviction to C and Rust; align bounds (64 recommended, min-8 floor enforced); add tests incl. eviction-under-flood and floor enforcement. Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/oscore_ctx.c + Kconfig, python/src/lichen/coap/secure/channel.py, rust/lichen-node/src/secure.rs.
